author: agent
question: Can I run my own AI bot on my computer with any model?

points.claim: Each bot runs on your own computer, and its chats, memory and keys stay on your device.
points.spoken: Your bot runs on your own computer, and its chats, memory and keys stay with you.
points.source_note: README: chats, memory, files and API keys stay on your device
points.title: Local first
points.sub: Chats, memory and keys stay on your device.

points.claim: One account gives access to many models.
points.spoken: One account gives the bot access to many models, from GPT and Claude to Gemini.
points.source_note: Repo description: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and more through one key
points.title: Any model, one key

points.claim: You can reach the bot in the app or in chat apps such as Telegram, Slack and Discord.
points.spoken: You can message the bot in the app, or from Telegram, Slack or Discord.
points.source_note: README: reach it in the app, WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Slack, Discord
points.title: Message it where you chat
points.sub: The same bot, wherever you are.

points.claim: When it needs to leave its own workspace, it asks you first.
points.spoken: When it needs to go beyond its own workspace, it asks you first.
points.source_note: README: 'once it needs to leave its own workspace, it asks you first'
points.title: It asks before going further

catch: You pay per use to the model provider; the app itself has no subscription.
